LanguageData.RD_Rec1: Safe riding: Giddy-Up repaired, failed mounting undone, endless retries paused
LanguageData.RD_Rec2: Riders get off before boarding; the animal rides along as cargo
LanguageData.RD_Rec3: Back on the animal after getting out; caravans ride too
LanguageData.RD_Rec4: Passenger seats ×2, vehicles without passenger places get some
LanguageData.RD_NoGiddyUp: Giddy-Up is not in the game – this page does nothing.
LanguageData.RD_NeedBoth: Needs both Giddy-Up and Vehicle Framework – one of them is missing.
LanguageData.RD_NoVehicles: Vehicle Framework is not in the game – this page does nothing.
LanguageData.RD_SafeMounting_Desc: If another mod broke Giddy-Up's start, the list of mountable animals and the rider offsets are repaired. A mounting that throws halfway is undone cleanly instead of leaving the rider half on the animal.
LanguageData.RD_MountPause_Desc: A rider whose mounting keeps failing (5 tries within an hour, or a mounting that threw) takes a break before trying again. Your own orders still go through. This stops the endless retry that could crash the game.
LanguageData.RD_PauseHours_Desc: How long a rider waits before trying to mount again (game hours).
LanguageData.RD_DismountToBoard_Desc: A rider gets off his animal properly before getting into a vehicle (before, he simply vanished from under Giddy-Up and the animal was left confused).
LanguageData.RD_AnimalPlace_Desc: What the animal does while its rider is in a vehicle.
LanguageData.RD_Place_Cargo_Desc: The animal goes into the vehicle's cargo if it fits (by weight). If not, it waits next to the vehicle.
LanguageData.RD_Place_Wait_Desc: The animal stays next to the vehicle (tied up if it is an animal that can be roped).
LanguageData.RD_Place_Free_Desc: The animal is left to itself.
LanguageData.RD_RideToVehicle_Desc: Riders stay on their animal while going to board, follow or escort a vehicle, instead of parking it 25 cells away and walking.
LanguageData.RD_RemountAfter_Desc: After getting out of a vehicle the rider takes his animal out of the cargo (if it rode along) and gets back on.
LanguageData.RD_KeepOwnership_Desc: While the rider is inside the vehicle, the animal stays reserved for him – he is not sent to lead it to the pen and nobody else takes it.
LanguageData.RD_CaravanMounts_Desc: Colonists walking with a vehicle caravan ride their own animals, and get back on them when the caravan arrives (Giddy-Up does this only for caravans without vehicles).
LanguageData.RD_Seats_Desc: Passenger seats are changed on the vehicle types – new vehicles, loaded ones and those on the map all get it. Driver and gunner seats are never touched. Nobody is thrown out when seats go down.
LanguageData.RD_PassengerMult_Desc: Every vehicle's passenger seats multiplied (rounded up).
LanguageData.RD_AddSeats: Seats for vehicles without passenger places
LanguageData.RD_AddSeats_Desc: Vehicles that only have a driver (or gunners) get a passenger place with 1–4 seats by their size.
LanguageData.RD_PerVehicle_Desc: Add or remove passenger seats on a single vehicle. Shown: crew seats · passenger seats originally → now.
LanguageData.RD_StSetupRepaired: Giddy-Up's start was broken by another mod – repaired.
LanguageData.RD_StCounts: This session: {0} failed mountings undone · {1} riders paused · {2} got off to board · {3} got back on
LanguageData.RD_StSeats: Seats: {0} vehicle types changed · {1} got a passenger place
LanguageData.RD_LogMountThrew: {0} could not get on {1} ({2}) – undone, next try in {3} h.
LanguageData.RD_LogMountLoop: {0} kept trying to get on {1} without success – next try in {3} h.
LanguageData.RD_NoMountCarrying_Desc: A colonist who carries a corpse or a person (or is going to) walks instead of first going to get on an animal. Getting on with the load in his arms kept failing and he tried again and again.
